observations.visible: Under street works the lower lights are partly boarded; many upper sash frames are pale and some are open. The shaped window heads, rectangular steel grid and shorter easternmost group remain legible. The museum model represents the photographed post-repair windows.

Rectangular steel glazing with heavier central stile; four columns and six horizontal courses on the full-sized street sash. Two columns and six courses on each narrow short-wall light. Alternating segmental/triangular stone heads remain separate from the rectangular glazing.

The courtyard wall has an alternating group of triangular and flat heads at the corresponding storey. Two wider, staggered landing lights are partly hidden behind the trees. The adjacent rooftop/courtyard structures are recorded separately.
